* fix(release-note): improve hydration handling in ReleaseNoteBanner component (#1436)

- Default hasHydrated state to false to prevent SSR access to persist before hydration.
- Added checks for the existence of the persist API to ensure safe hydration handling.
- Updated useEffect to set hasHydrated correctly after hydration is complete.

These changes enhance the reliability of the ReleaseNoteBanner component during server-side rendering and improve overall performance.

* feat(chat): Gazai-chan 升級大腦 gemini-3-flash-preview (#1437)

* fix(release-note): improve hydration handling in ReleaseNoteBanner component

- Default hasHydrated state to false to prevent SSR access to persist before hydration.
- Added checks for the existence of the persist API to ensure safe hydration handling.

These changes enhance the reliability of the ReleaseNoteBanner component during server-side rendering and improve overall performance.

* fix(api): update default CHAT_AGENT_MODEL to 'gemini-3-flash-preview'

- Changed the default value of CHAT_AGENT_MODEL in the chat API from 'gemini-3-pro-preview' to 'gemini-3-flash-preview' for improved performance and alignment with the latest AI tools.
- Updated the ai-tool-search module to reflect the new default model, ensuring consistency across the application.

These changes enhance the functionality of the chat API and maintain compatibility with the latest AI features.

* fix(canvas): upgrade AI chat agent to create TextV2 objects (#1439)

* fix(canvas): upgrade AI chat agent to create TextV2 objects instead of legacy Text

The AI chat agent (Gazai-chan) was creating old TextObject (speech bubble) when
adding text to the canvas. This updates it to create TextV2Object which supports
inline editing, visual scaling on transform, and richer formatting (bold, italic,
underline, font family, text color).

* feat(gemini): add Banana 2 / Gemini 3 model support (#1443)

* feat(gemini): update Gemini model descriptions and add new models

- Enhanced the Gemini model selector by adding new models: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash Preview, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview.
- Updated model descriptions for clarity and added a new description for the newly introduced Nano Banana 2 model.
- Introduced a new workflow for updating Gazai Dev Standup Meeting and Slack notifications post-PR creation, ensuring better tracking and communication of development progress.

These changes improve the functionality and usability of the Gemini model management and enhance team collaboration during development.

* fix(gemini): update ad ideas generation model to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image

- Changed the ad ideas generation model from Gemini 3 Flash Preview to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for improved performance and alignment with current capabilities.
- This update ensures the model used for generating ad ideas is optimized for the latest features and enhancements.

* refactor(tests): update mockGemini to use imported model constants

- Replaced hardcoded model strings in mockGemini with imported constants from the Gemini models module.
- This change improves maintainability and ensures consistency with the latest model definitions.

* fix(gemini): update default field handling in GeminiParameterSchemaBuilder

- Modified the initialization logic to ensure default fields are set in form.parameterSchema when no schemaStr is provided. This prevents the UI from displaying default fields while the JSON preview remains empty until user interaction.
- Enhanced the form.setValue call to include options for shouldDirty, shouldTouch, and shouldValidate, improving form state management and user experience.

* feat(canvas): auto-place objects at viewport/container center on tool select (#1438)

* feat(canvas): auto-place objects at viewport center on tool select (TSK-4131)

When no container (Panel/Frame) is selected, clicking a creation tool
(textV2, speech, shapes, image, frame) now immediately places the object
at the viewport center instead of requiring a click on the canvas.

Includes AABB collision avoidance — if the center is occupied, the new
object shifts down by 40px (up to 20 attempts). Also applies collision
avoidance to image generation placeholder positioning.

* feat(canvas): auto-place objects inside selected Frame/Panel center (TSK-4130)

When a Frame or Panel is selected, clicking a creation tool (textV2,
speech, shapes, image) now directly places the object at the container's
center as a child, instead of requiring a separate click on the canvas.

Objects are positioned in canvas-absolute coordinates with parentId set
and the container's children array updated — consistent with existing
mouse-event creation patterns.

* feat(canvas): update default sizes for frame (3200x1800) and shape (circle 900)

- Frame default: 16:9 aspect ratio at 3200x1800
- Shape default: circle with diameter 900
- Change shape fallback type from rectangle to circle

* fix(canvas): center shape in frame and add shape selection/transform support

- Fix shape not centered when auto-placed inside a frame by offsetting
  position to account for ShapeNode's center-origin rendering
- Add showTransformer, isMultiSelect, and onTransformEnd to ShapeNode
  inside frame-node (matching ImageNode/TextV2Node pattern)
- Add absolutePosition param to handleShapeTransformEnd for frame-relative
  to absolute coordinate conversion

* fix(canvas): allow Ctrl+click multi-select on circle shapes

The clickedOnCorner check used `e.target instanceof Konva.Circle` which
matched both Transformer anchor circles AND user-created Circle shapes.
Add parent check to only match circles that are Transformer children.

* feat(canvas): require explicit shape selection before auto-placing

Remove auto-creation of circle shape when clicking the shapes toolbar
button. Now the popover opens first, and the shape is only created
after the user picks a specific shape type from the menu.

* fix(canvas): fix collision detection for auto-placed objects

Two bugs caused objects to stack at the same position:

1. Shape position semantic mismatch — ShapeObjects store `position` as
   visual center (for Konva offsetX/offsetY), but collision detection
   assumed top-left, producing wrong bounding boxes.

2. Fixed 40px step couldn't clear large objects — MAX_ATTEMPTS(20) ×
   OFFSET_STEP(40) = 800px, which is less than Shape(900), Image(1024),
   and Frame(1800) sizes.

Fix: add getObstacleBounds() that handles shape center→top-left
conversion, and replace fixed-step shifting with dynamic jumping
(skip directly below the lowest overlapping obstacle + gap).

* fix(canvas): allow consecutive frame creation with collision avoidance

Two issues prevented creating multiple frames:

1. After creating a frame, it became selected — the routing logic
   then blocked the frame tool because 'frame' is not in
   CONTAINER_PLACE_TOOLS. Fix: bypass container-selection check
   for the frame tool.

2. Frames were excluded from collision obstacles (filtered by
   isContainerObject). Fix: add `includeFrames` option to
   findNonOverlappingViewportCenter, enabled for frame creation.

* fix(canvas): auto-enter editing mode when TextV2 is auto-placed

TextV2 created via useAutoPlaceOnToolSelect only called selectTextV2
(selection) but not setEditingTextV2Id (editing mode), so the
FloatingTextV2Editor never appeared.

Fix: add onTextV2Created callback to useAutoPlaceOnToolSelect, wired
to setEditingTextV2Id in gazai-canvas.tsx.

* fix(test): add missing Konva.Transformer mock in mouse events test

The Konva mock was missing a Transformer class, causing
`instanceof Konva.Transformer` to throw TypeError.

* fix(canvas): make frame background semi-transparent during resize

Match the dragging behavior by setting frame background to
rgba(255,255,255,0.5) while resizing, then restoring the original
fill on transform end.

* feat(canvas): auto-pan viewport to newly placed objects outside visible area

When collision avoidance pushes a new object beyond the viewport, or when
an image generation placeholder/result lands off-screen, the viewport now
smoothly pans to center on the object without changing zoom level.

* refactor(canvas): extract shared animation engine from viewport methods

Extract runAnimationLoop and getViewportCenter helpers to deduplicate
animation boilerplate across animateScale, animatePanTo, and scaleToFit.
Rewrite scaleToFit as two-phase overlapping animation (pan first, then
zoom) for smoother layer-panel focus navigation.

* docs(canvas): add viewport animation deep-dive document

Add Level 2 topic covering shared animation infrastructure,
three animation methods, two-phase overlap timing, and caller inventory.

* fix(chat): resolve 4K reference image error in Gazai Chan (TSK-4128) (#1441)

* fix(chat): resize 4K images before sending as chat attachments and Gemini references (TSK-4128)

4K Gemini-generated images are stored as large base64 data URLs in canvas
object src (~10-20+ MB). When sent back to Gazai Chan as chat attachments,
these bloat the API request body beyond server limits. Similarly, when used
as reference images for generation, the full-resolution image exceeds
Gemini API inline data limits.

- Add resizeDataUrlForChat() in chat-image-utils.ts (client-side, 1024px max)
- Add resizeBase64ForGemini() in utils/server/image.ts (server-side, 1536px max)
- Wire resize into chat.tsx wrappedHandleSubmit with try/catch fallback
- Wire resize into Gemini route processImageId before inline data conversion

* fix(chat): address PR review — pixel bomb guard, per-file fallback, white background for JPEG

- Add MAX_PIXEL_COUNT guard to resizeDataUrlForChat() to prevent memory
  exhaustion from extremely large data URL images
- Change Promise.all to Promise.allSettled in chat submit so a single
  failed resize falls back individually instead of reverting all images
- Fill white background before JPEG export in resizeDataUrlForChat(),
  resizeImageToDataUrl(), and resizeBase64ForGemini() to prevent
  transparent PNG areas from becoming black
- Update test mocks with fillRect support

* chore: add Claude Code slash commands for PR workflow and standup worklog

- commit-push-pr: commit, push, create PR with reviewers, update Notion standup, send Slack notification to #gazai-canvas
- standup-worklog: compile yesterday/today work log from Notion tasks and GitHub PRs

Mirrors the existing Cursor rules (pr-slack-notify.mdc, standup-worklog-flow.mdc) for Claude Code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(chat): replace base64 data URL with S3 URL for canvas image attachments (TSK-4162) (#1445)

* feat(chat): replace base64 data URL with S3 URL for canvas image attachments (TSK-4162)

Canvas chat attachments now use S3/CloudFront URLs instead of base64 data URLs,
eliminating payload bloat (from ~12 MB to ~500 bytes per 4K image).

- Add fetchS3UrlsByIds() for batch S3 URL lookup via /api/images/src?format=url
- imageObjectToAttachment() accepts optional s3Url, falls back to obj.src
- buildCanvasAttachmentsFromSelection() is now async, batch-fetches S3 URLs
- Update chat-footer-form useEffect for async attachment building
- Add 6 new test cases for S3 URL behavior, update existing tests for async

* fix(chat): resolve TypeScript narrowing error in fetchS3UrlsByIds

Extract urls[i] to a local variable so TypeScript can narrow
string | null to string inside the if-guard.

* feat(chat): upload large images via Gemini Files API to bypass 20MB inline limit

When total image size in a chat request exceeds 15 MB, large images
(>4 MB each) are uploaded to Gemini Files API and referenced via
fileData.fileUri instead of inlineData. This supports multi-image
4K reference scenarios that would otherwise exceed Gemini's 20 MB
inline data limit.

- Add lib/gemini/files.ts with uploadLargeImagesToGeminiFiles()
- Integrate in chat route after convertToModelMessages() (Gemini only)
- @ai-sdk/google natively supports URL objects as fileData.fileUri

* docs(chat): add image data flow architecture to Gazai-chan chat docs

Document the 3-stage image pipeline (client → server → Gemini),
S3 URL attachment flow, and Gemini Files API trigger conditions.

* refactor(chat): use DataUIPart + convertDataPart for canvas image handling

Refactored per Jack's suggestion to use AI SDK's DataUIPart pattern:
- Frontend sends canvas images as DataUIPart with imageDbId (not S3 URL)
- Backend resolves imageDbId to S3 URL via convertDataPart callback
- Removed client-side S3 URL fetch (fetchS3UrlsByIds)
- buildCanvasAttachmentsFromSelection is sync again (no network calls)
- ChatAttachment carries imageDbId for backend resolution
- Upload images still use FileUIPart with data URL (unchanged)

* fix(chat): make convertDataPart synchronous with pre-resolved S3 URLs

convertToModelMessages' convertDataPart callback does not await Promises —
async callbacks silently produce empty objects instead of FileParts.

Fix: pre-resolve all canvas image DB IDs to S3 URLs before calling
convertToModelMessages, then use the pre-built map synchronously
in convertDataPart.

* fix(chat): display canvas image thumbnails in chat message bubbles

DataUIPart (data-canvas-image) now carries displayUrl for thumbnail
rendering. chat-message-bubble renders both FileUIParts (uploads)
and DataUIParts (canvas images) in the attachment gallery.

* fix(chat): use S3 URL instead of base64 data URL for canvas image displayUrl (#1447)

Canvas images attached to chat messages were using the Konva image.src
(base64 data URL, ~10 MB per image) as displayUrl in the message parts.
Since useChat sends the full message history on every request, this caused
the payload to exceed Vercel's body size limit (413 Content Too Large)
after just a few rounds of conversation.

Replace the base64 displayUrl with the S3 URL fetched via the existing
/api/images/src?format=url endpoint. The chat bubble thumbnail (64x64)
loads from S3, and the server already resolves images via imageDbId.

* feat(text-models): TextModel CRUD and Gemini selector integration (#1446)

* feat(text-models): implement CRUD functionality for text models

- Added new pages for managing text models, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting models.
- Introduced a search form for filtering text models based on various parameters.
- Implemented API routes for handling text model data, including validation and permission checks.
- Enhanced UI components for better user experience and responsiveness.

These changes provide a comprehensive management interface for text models, improving usability and functionality within the admin panel.

* fix(text-models): enhance error handling for text model operations

- Added error translation for user feedback in the inline sort order cell, text model actions, and text model form components.
- Implemented specific error handling for duplicate text model entries in the API routes, returning appropriate status codes and messages.
- Updated error messages in multiple languages to ensure consistency across the application.

These changes improve the user experience by providing clearer error messages and handling edge cases more effectively.

* fix: address PR review feedback

- Fix Japanese translation for 'enabled' in admin messages
- Fix untranslated English strings in Simplified Chinese admin messages
- Resolve stale closure issue in text-model-search-form.tsx
- Introduce and use dedicated TEXT_MODEL_* error IDs instead of AI_TOOL_*

Made-with: Cursor

* pencil home page design

* fix(chat): resolve batch image generation cooldown failure in GAZAI Chan (#1449)

* fix(chat): resolve batch image generation cooldown failure in GAZAI Chan

When GAZAI Chan returns multiple generateImage tool calls, AI SDK
processes them sequentially. Previously, each tool call awaited the
full generation (30+ seconds), and the 500ms post-completion cooldown
caused all subsequent tool calls to fail with GENERATION_COOLDOWN.

Change handleParallelGeneration to fire-and-forget so all tool calls
return immediately and generations run concurrently (up to the user's
concurrentLimit). The startGeneration() call inside
handleParallelGeneration increments activeGenerations synchronously
before yielding, so subsequent canGenerate() checks correctly enforce
the concurrent limit.

* feat(chat): offset batch-generated images horizontally to prevent stacking

When GAZAI Chan generates multiple images, offset each image's position
horizontally by (width + 40px gap) × activeGenerationCount. This uses
the parallel generation store's activeCount which increments synchronously
in each fire-and-forget call, giving each tool call a unique index.

* fix(chat): show "request sent" instead of "completed" for batch generation

The chat bubble title showed "✓ 生成圖片完成" (completed) even though
the generation was just started (fire-and-forget). Now it correctly
shows "✓ 生成圖片請求已發送" (request sent) when generationStarted
flag is present in the tool result.

* fix(canvas): ensure AI-created text stays visible above generated images (#1448)

* fix(canvas): ensure AI-created text stays visible above generated images

When Gazai-chan creates both text and images in the same conversation turn,
text objects end up behind images in the layer stack because new objects are
appended to the end of the canvasObjects array. This tracks AI-created text
IDs and brings them to front after each image generation completes.

- Single video playback: when a video starts playing (hover/tap),
  all other playing videos are paused automatically
- Add i18n error messages for all 4 locales (en/ja/zh-CN/zh-TW)

* fix(canvas): address PR review feedback from Katie

- Extract MAX_VIDEO_FILE_SIZE and MAX_VIDEO_DURATION to module-level
  constants for readability
- Clear file input via videoFileInputRef when duration validation
  fails inside onloadeddata callback (prevents same-file re-select

  instead of !draggingImageId to ensure the floating toolbar always

VideoNode inside a frame was rendered using absolute canvas coordinates
instead of frame-relative coordinates, causing videos to appear at the

* fix(canvas): enable hover-to-play for videos inside frames

VideoNode rendered inside FrameNode was missing the
onPlaybackStateChange callback, so hover/tap events could not update

single-playback logic (pause all other videos when one starts).
